mirror_rule: flip horizontally around the frame centre line x = 32.0; pivot stays (32, 56)
height_rule: pivot row (ground under the feet) to the top visible pixel, outline included
notes: Огнея Пепельная (былинный враг M1, дух пожара): hovering ash shroud and hood, pale face, flame hair, smouldering hem and forearms. Hovers 2.5±1 px above the ground (pivot = ground point under her; keep the shadow on the ground). Body 48-50 incl. hover, flame hair ≤ 53, raised fire bolt ≤ 55 (scale.md: 48, flames to 54). Frame 64x64, pivot (32,56).

events.sync: attackTime 2.0 s, hitAt 0.7 s: start the 10 fps anim at t = 0.4 s so frame 3 is at 0.7 s
